recent_posts.title: Weekly Vue News #238 - Nuxt UI v4, business wins with Nuxt, and VueUse
recent_posts.summary: Weekly Vue News #238 curates the latest in Vue and Nuxt development. Highlights include Nuxt UI v4 with 125+ accessible components, a look at business advantages of using Nuxt for SEO and performance, and a guide on supercharging Nuxt apps with VueUse. Also featured: tutorials on Vue render functions, Vue slots, building 3D scenes with TresJS, and a conversation with Eduardo San Martin Morote (Pinia creator, Vue Router maintainer) on the future of state management and routing. Additional tools include a high-performance infinite list loader, a TypeScript logging library for Nitro, and TanStack Hotkeys.

recent_posts.title: Weekly Vue News #237 - Top Nuxt Modules for 2026, TypeScript 6.0 Beta, and AI Content Tools
recent_posts.summary: TypeScript 6.0 Beta is released as the last version based on the current JavaScript codebase, with TypeScript 7.0+ moving to a Go-based compiler. Nuxt releases v4.3.1 and v3.21.1 with fixes for path encoding, visual flashes, and CSS flickering. Nuxt UI v4.4.0 adds editor improvements and new component features. JavaScript is getting a 'using' keyword for automatic resource cleanup. The newsletter also highlights top Nuxt modules for 2026, AI-powered content assistance in Nuxt Studio, and various community tools and events.
